title: Proposed After-State · Shared-Driver Semantic VQ
subtitle: Raw-only modality streams · independent K=128 · full joint-driver-proxy trajectory · scoped frozen evaluation
banner: PLAN, not runtime · R1-P panel and R2-P must pass before VQ migration; no R-series scientific gate has run.
summary: Return to independent raw-physiology tokenizers while using one full joint-driver proxy trajectory as the semantic coordinate; remove multi-entry shaping and separate offline association from strict-cutoff future prediction.

changes.note: Replace sparse mean/slope sidecars with a versioned full-trajectory joint-driver sidecar.
Reduce the multi-entry router to a trajectory slicer and explicit loss-mask intersection.
Both modalities receive the same full joint-driver coordinate without same-ID supervision.
Replace modality-specific HbO/HbR state summaries with the common full joint-driver target.
Use one explicit support intersection in training, validation, and frozen probes.
Keep raw EEG patch embeddings but remove patch-local token identity.
Use the existing encoder position as a modality-specific patch feature stem.
Move temporal context before semantic projection and quantization to match the full-window teacher.
Semantic latent is now produced from the full-window modality-only encoder.
Remove the mandatory residual branch from the minimal core; a continuous private path is an R4 ablation only.

changes.note: Make full joint-driver trajectory reconstruction the primary semantic objective and remove raw reconstruction from the core.
Require dual-modality continuous observability before allowing the K128 semantic run.
Replace the required foundation stage with a development frozen q0/q1 evaluator for offline association.
Future prediction is a separate strict-cutoff mode; it is invalid when token receptive fields overlap the endpoint.
